title: Rabbi Levi bar Tarfon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 1:33, where Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon speaks in his name; but Hyman says the reading should be “bar Parta,” as the statement is cited in Vayikra Rabbah 23:12.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Midrash Rabbah — TE text of Eichah Rabbah 1:33 has Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon reporting Rabbi Levi beRabbi Tarfon; Vayikra Rabbah 23:12 has Rabbi Yehudah beRabbi Simon reporting Rabbi Levi ben Parta. These passages support the local full titles and the contrasting patronymics. Hyman’s “should read” remains his proposed emendation; no father or identity is harmonized.
